limits.coverage: Disposable apply rebinds its owned coverage inputs. Whole-repository coverage replay, generated copies and checks are separate final composition obligations.
limits.history: Preserved commit, path-tree and blob objects prove this bounded baseline; parent ancestry, signatures and historical execution are not verified here. No Git fetch or model call occurs during verification.
limits.observations: Raw owner records bind the measured bytes and model answers. Offline verification recomputes owner semantics and digests; it does not independently recount model tokens, establish model quality or authenticate the acquisition clock.
limits.profiles: Profile observed_on remains 2026-09-12; separate UTC started_at and finished_at fields record the fresh 2026-09-13 calls. No failed acquisition occurred on this attempt.
limits.publication: Atomic exchange retains displaced files in journal-bound publication and restoration slots. Exact-syscall guards preserve third and fourth versions and refuse recovery with a conflict; unsupported hosts or filesystems refuse without replacement fallback. Exchange-induced ctime is excluded from stable identity comparison. The journal covers handled failure and killed processes, including a kill immediately after exchange; it does not claim hardware power-loss atomicity. The earlier successful vulnerable-writer attempt remains preserved. The repaired publication reused the fresh reports only after all 28 acquisition inputs were proven byte-identical.
